comparison_decision.explanation: The source inputs already include ground transfer, but TABULA further adds unheated-cellar resistance Radd=0.3 to produce the listed Ueff values. Separately, b=0.5 multiplies area times Ueff in the transmission balance; the listed Ueff values do not already contain this factor. These historical observations are preserved for audit and are not compatible nominal-layer acceptance targets. Removing only Radd does not produce independently validated ISO 13370 renovated targets.
required_for_forward_assessment: Ground-contact geometry, area/perimeter and burial depth
Matching ISO 13370 or other declared ground-transfer calculation and original/reference geometry
not_allowed: Reverse-solving insulation or conductivity from effective U
Adding cellar R=0.3 or b=0.5 to physical layer definitions
Counting an unavailable comparison as a pass

workbook_equations.separate_transmission_term: Htr,element = 0.5 × area × Ueff; factor 0.5 is separate from the listed Ueff
workbook_equations.original_input_basis: Uinput is the ground-inclusive BETSI stock mean, not a bare-layer U.

catalogue_changes.boundary_metadata: All three MF SE.01 states map GROUND_FLOOR to conditioned_basement_floor and TABULA_WALL_2 to BASEMENT_WALL/conditioned_basement_wall, both soil-facing. Definitions remain geometry-selected.
catalogue_changes.generic_fallback: Uses the same MF definitions; no new family is created.
catalogue_changes.floor_finish: Baseline now includes an 80 mm period-supported cement-finished concrete topping above LECA, retained under standard/advanced EPS overlays. See evidence/mf_se01_basement_floor_finish.json; no source U is fitted.

completion_assumptions.material: Reuse generic stone-wool batts lambda 0.036, density 29 kg/m3, Honeybee EPSM_mineral_wool and Boverket 6000000123. The source names stone-wool facade board; this internal-lining family adaptation is explicit.
completion_assumptions.finish: 13 mm gypsum board; not prescribed by TABULA.
